<!-- pr-reviewer: 1f903bd42d46940821c5045b747473fa03e5be3c -->
**Needs changes before merge.** Two small blockers (below). The script, the web files and the new dependencies also need a maintainer look; the browser run itself was not reproduced here.

Reviewed head 1f903bd4, trial-merged with origin/main 2046357b: clean, no conflicts. The merge was committed locally only, not pushed.

Reminder: this PR is stacked on #841. Retarget it to `main` (`gh pr edit 847 --base main`) before #841 merges, or GitHub closes it when the base branch is deleted.

## What looks good

- **Dependencies:** no new crate enters Cargo.lock. The lock diff is three lines, all in camcraft-ui's dependency list (eframe, wasm-bindgen, wasm-bindgen-futures), and each already had a single version in the lock. `eframe = "=0.36.2"` matches the egui `=0.36.2` stack. The three new deps are under `cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")` (crates/ui/Cargo.toml). `pollster` moved to the native-only table; its remaining uses in camcraft-ui are native code or a `#[test]` (gpu.rs:226).
- **The move is faithful:** the `view_pass.rs` functions match the blocks removed from `shell_window/frame.rs` (base vs head). The native frame now calls them, and `redraw_delay` moved with its tests.
- **One implementation per async twin:** `TracePass::new`, `Composite::new`, `StockEye::new` and `headless_gpu::device` are `block_on` wrappers over the `*_async` bodies, not copies.
- **Start-up failures reach the page:** no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `shell_web.rs`, `view_pass.rs` or `trace/readback.rs`. `camcraft_start` validates the canvas id (shell_web.rs:58-62). Refusals go to `#camcraft-status` and the console (shell_web.rs:81-87). index.html:45-46 turns uncaught errors and rejections into the same message.
- **Scoping:** the `allow(dead_code)` in lib.rs:14 is `cfg_attr(target_arch = "wasm32")` only, so the native lint is unchanged.
- **CI:** the ci.yml diff against the base is comment-only. Triggers are still `workflow_dispatch` only (ci.yml:12-13).
- **Process:** no snapshot PNG changed. The decisions file is present (`docs/decisions/31-wasm-web-runner.md`). There is a `Changelog:` line and `Refs #31`. No PROCESS_VERSION bump is needed, since `web/` and a comment-only ci.yml edit are not on the process list.
- **Web files:** index.html and wasi_shim.js load no remote script, font, CDN or analytics URL, and use no `eval`. The only network fetch in the script is the wasi-sysroot download, pinned by sha256 (build-app-wasm.sh:57-61).

## Local results (trial-merge tree, native only)

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd crates/ui) | 484 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `view_pass::tests::target_extent_is_never_zero_and_scales_with_the_pixel_ratio` | ok |
| `view_pass::tests::a_browser_frame_with_no_egui_timer_still_follows_the_document` | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean (exit 0) |

Not run: the wasm32 build and `web/build-app-wasm.sh` (rule: read, not built), the browser, any `--ignored` lane, the snapshot tests, and the other crates (no change there apart from main).

## Requested before merge

1. **crates/ui/src/trace/eye.rs:118** - the TracePass refusal goes to `eprintln!`. std has no stderr on wasm32-unknown-unknown, so on the browser path this line is discarded, and the eye falls back to the CPU march with no message. AGENTS.md: "Log diagnostics, never silence." Fix: on wasm32, send the line to the console (for example through a `console_log` helper), or carry the note back in the `Ok` value so shell_web prints it.
2. **web/wasi_shim.js:116-119** - the comment says `poll_oneoff` lets "the caller's sleep return at once", but the function returns `ERRNO_NOSYS` (52). The C caller gets an error it may ignore. Pick one behaviour and make the comment match it: either return SUCCESS with `nevents` written as 0, or keep NOSYS and say where that error ends up.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- **build-app-wasm.sh:146:** under `set -o pipefail`, if no WASI imports are found the assignment fails and the script exits before the `die` message. It still fails closed; the message is what is missing.
- **build-app-wasm.sh:132 (maintainer look):** when PATH has no matching wasm-bindgen, `cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version <lock version> --locked --root target/wasm-tools/bindgen` fetches the CLI from crates.io and builds it, so its build scripts run. The version follows Cargo.lock as the PR says. The CLI is not in the workspace lock and has no checksum in the repo.
- **wasi_shim.js:35-41 and 68-73:** clock ids other than CLOCK_REALTIME are answered with `performance.now()` without a message, and `fd_read` returns EOF silently. Neither is among the nine imports the build reports, so no effect today. If an import is added later, these would be silent.
- **shell_web.rs:135:** the first target size is not clamped to 0.1..8 like the frame paths (shell_web.rs:214, shell_window.rs:203). Only the first frame is affected.
- **Sizes:** shell.rs 923 -> 926 (already over 400; the PR adds three lines for the cfg and a comment). frame.rs 409 -> 358. trace.rs 411 -> 342 (the body says 343). Not blocking.
- **Evidence:** the headless Chrome run is the author's; I did not reproduce it. The "not exercised" list (WebGPU, the awaited eye past its guard, the refusal paths, anything past the first click, the file picker) matches what the code shows.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b6483d6698f5534323f111b80de5d464409220ce -->
**Delta review of head b6483d66 (against the needs-changes review of 1f903bd4)**

Verdict: no blockers. Both requested changes are resolved and the native build, tests and clippy are clean on a trial merge with origin/main (bdd29e00). The PR still carries the wasm32-only dependencies, the build script's CLI install from crates.io, the new `web/` files and the ci.yml comment, so it is left for the maintainer to look at and merge by hand.

**Requested changes from the earlier review**

1. Resolved. `crates/ui/src/trace/eye.rs:118` (and the other TracePass refusals in that file, lines ~211, ~269, ~278, ~289) now go through `diag_warn!`, which is `console.warn` on wasm32 and `eprintln!` natively. The message text is unchanged.
2. Resolved. `web/wasi_shim.js` `poll_oneoff` now returns ESUCCESS, writes one event per subscription (userdata copied, error 0 for clocks, type set), sets `nevents`, and warns once in the console. A descriptor subscription gets ENOTSUP with its own warning.

**Notes from the earlier review**

- `web/build-app-wasm.sh`: the import list is read with `|| true`, so the named `die` message now prints (`build-app-wasm.sh` ~line 162).
- The wasm-bindgen install prints the exact command and source first. `CAMCRAFT_WASM_NO_INSTALL=1` calls `die` (which exits) before the install line, so the refusal cannot fall through to the install.
- The shim exports exactly the nine imports the author lists. Unknown clock ids return EINVAL and closed descriptors return EBADF, each with a console warning.
- `view_pass::target_extent` clamps the pixel ratio to 0.1..=8 (1 for NaN), with an extended test covering zero, negative, huge, infinite and NaN ratios.
- `ci.yml` triggers are still `workflow_dispatch` only. No snapshot PNG is changed. `shell.rs` is not touched by this delta.

**What looks good**

- The diag seam keeps native output the same stream and text. The wasm32 arm uses `eframe::web_sys::console`, which `shell_web.rs` already uses; no new crate enters Cargo.lock (only dependency edges on existing packages are added).
- Spot-checked five swept prints against main; the text is unchanged (`icons.rs` "icon {icon:?} unavailable", `panes.rs` "ribbon: unknown op kind", `state.rs` "settle: queued work did not finish...", `lib.rs` "--ui needs a value...", `eye.rs` "stock eye: ... the CPU march stands in").
- The `poll_oneoff` event layout matches the WASI preview1 offsets (event size 32, error at 8, type at 10; clock subscription timeout at 24).

**Local results (trial merge of b6483d66 with origin/main bdd29e00, native)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (crates/ui) | ok, 513 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored (release-lane snapshots and heavy playback bench, not run) |
| `diag::tests::shared_ui_code_prints_only_through_the_diag_seam` | ok |
| `diag::tests::the_macros_take_println_shaped_arguments` | ok |
| `view_pass` tests (target_extent, browser frame) | ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Finished, exit 0 |

Not built or run: wasm32 (not allowed for this review), `web/build-app-wasm.sh`, any browser, the release tier, and the `--ignored` lanes.

**Requested before merge**

None blocking.

**Questions and notes (not blocking)**

1. The law test can be fooled in a few ways. It matches text on each line, so `writeln!(std::io::stderr(), ...)`, `io::stderr().write_all`, or a direct `stdout()` write would pass. It exempts whole files (`egui_app/shell.rs`, `egui_app/gpu.rs`, `egui_app/gpu_init.rs`), so a new print added to those files is not caught; a per-function or per-`cfg` exemption would be narrower. It also cuts each line at the first `//`, so a `//` inside a string literal on a line hides any print after it on that line. The exemptions for test files and native-only files are otherwise justified (I checked: shell.rs prints at ~878/930 sit in the `cfg(not(wasm32))` headless module; gpu.rs prints sit in `#[cfg(test)]` at line 132).
2. `poll_oneoff` reports the sleep as elapsed, and the console warning is said once per process. A caller that sleeps in a retry loop would spin, and after the first warning it does so silently. Consider a counter in the warning, or a warning per N skipped waits.
3. The PR body says the `web/index.html` icon link was added after the browser run and not re-run. Acceptable, but the maintainer should know the final page was not loaded.
4. The shim's nine-import list was checked by reading, not by running the build script (which was not allowed).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
